card: Removes noexcept from LogOversizedDbCache so invalid dbcache settings trigger a clean startup failure instead of crashing bitcoind. When settings.json contains a non-integer or out-of-range dbcache value (e.g., 4096.5), GetIntArg throws std::runtime_error, which hit the noexcept boundary and caused std::terminate to abort the process. Removing noexcept lets AppInit catch the exception and exit with status 1 and an informative error message.
changed_since_previous: Added a functional test checking that a valid integer `dbcache` setting from `settings.json` is applied correctly, in addition to testing invalid float rejection.
evidence: Author demonstrates the crash in PR description: `libc++abi: terminating due to uncaught exception of type std::runtime_error: JSON integer out of range`
problem: When `settings.json` specifies a non-integer or out-of-range value for `dbcache` (such as `4096.5`), `GetIntArg` throws `std::runtime_error`. Because `LogOversizedDbCache` was marked `noexcept`, this uncaught exception triggers `std::terminate` and immediately crashes `bitcoind` during startup instead of exiting cleanly.

risk.why: Uncaught exceptions during startup cache checks will now report an error in AppInit rather than calling std::terminate.

summary: Removes the `noexcept` specifier from `LogOversizedDbCache` and adds functional test cases for `dbcache` values in `settings.json`. This allows parse exceptions from `GetIntArg` to propagate to `AppInit` so the node exits with a diagnostic message rather than terminating abruptly.
